1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: // plan-seg-check.mjs — PLAN-SEG 机械校验器（planning-capability-design-20261022 v5 §5 的判定面）
3: // 用法: node plan-seg-check.mjs <ledger-file> [--plan <plan-file>] [--seglogs <dir>]
4: // 退出码: 0=全部通过 1=有违规(逐条打印) 2=用法/环境错误
5: // 判定面(机械可判): 字段齐备与顺序 / 段号连续 / 五格非占位 / plan 哈希匹配(--plan 时) /
6: // END 条目格式与日志哈希(--seglogs 时)。不判定"做得对不对"。
7: import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
8: import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
9: 
10: const US = "\x1f"; // ASCII 0x1F 单位分隔符
11: const SEG_TAGS = ["plan", "seg", "目标", "路径", "验收", "禁项", "回滚"];
12: const END_TAGS = ["seg", "cmd", "exit", "log_sha256"];
13: const PLACEHOLDER = /^(无|N\/A|TBD|待定|略)$/i;
14: const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
15: 
16: function fail(msg, violations) { violations.push(msg); }
17: 
18: function parseEntry(line, tags) {
19:   // 行形态: [PLAN-SEG]␟k1=v1␟k2=v2…  或  [PLAN-SEG-END]␟…
20:   const m = line.match(/^\[(PLAN-SEG(?:-END)?)\](.*)$/);
21:   if (!m) return null;
22:   const kind = m[1];
23:   const parts = m[2].split(US).filter((p) => p.length > 0);
24:   const out = { kind, fields: {} };
25:   for (let i = 0; i < tags.length; i++) {
26:     const p = parts[i];
27:     if (p === undefined) return { kind, error: `字段数不足: 期望 ${tags.length} 个, 实得 ${parts.length}` };
28:     const eq = p.indexOf("=");
29:     if (eq < 0 || p.slice(0, eq) !== tags[i]) {
30:       return { kind, error: `字段 ${i + 1} 应为 ${tags[i]}= 开头, 实得: ${p.slice(0, 24)}…` };
31:     }
32:     out.fields[tags[i]] = p.slice(eq + 1);
33:   }
34:   if (parts.length > tags.length) return { kind, error: `字段数超出: 期望 ${tags.length}, 实得 ${parts.length}` };
35:   return out;
36: }
37: 
38: function planHash(planFile) {
39:   // §2: 五格值逐格 trim、NFC、按 目标\n路径\n验收\n禁项\n回滚\n 拼接, UTF-8, sha256 前16
40:   const lines = readFileSync(planFile, "utf8").split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim() !== "");
41:   const grids = {};
42:   for (const l of lines) {
43:     const eq = l.indexOf("=");
44:     if (eq > 0) grids[l.slice(0, eq).trim()] = l.slice(eq + 1).trim();
45:   }
46:   const order = ["目标", "路径", "验收", "禁项", "回滚"];
47:   for (const g of order) if (!(g in grids)) throw new Error(`计划工件缺 ${g} 格`);
48:   const norm = order.map((g) => grids[g].normalize("NFC")).join("\n") + "\n";
49:   return createHash("sha256").update(norm, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
50: }
51: 
52: function main(argv) {
53:   const violations = [];
54:   const args = argv.slice(2);
55:   if (args.length < 1) { console.error("usage: node plan-seg-check.mjs <ledger> [--plan f] [--seglogs d]"); return 2; }
56:   const ledgerFile = args[0];
57:   const planFile = args.includes("--plan") ? args[args.indexOf("--plan") + 1] : null;
58:   const seglogs = args.includes("--seglogs") ? args[args.indexOf("--seglogs") + 1] : null;
59:   if (!existsSync(ledgerFile)) { console.error(`账本不存在: ${ledgerFile}`); return 2; }
60: 
61:   let expectHash = null;
62:   if (planFile) {
63:     try { expectHash = planHash(planFile); }
64:     catch (e) { console.error(`计划工件解析失败: ${e.message}`); return 2; }
65:   }
66: 
67:   const lines = readFileSync(ledgerFile, "utf8").split("\n");
68:   const segs = [];
69:   const ends = [];
70:   for (const [ln, raw] of lines.entries()) {
71:     const line = raw.trim();
72:     if (!line.startsWith("[PLAN-SEG")) continue;
73:     const isEnd = line.startsWith("[PLAN-SEG-END]");
74:     const e = parseEntry(line, isEnd ? END_TAGS : SEG_TAGS);
75:     if (!e) continue;
76:     if (e.error) { fail(`L${ln + 1}: ${e.error}`, violations); continue; }
77:     (isEnd ? ends : segs).push({ ...e, ln: ln + 1 });
78:   }
79: 
80:   if (segs.length === 0) fail("账本中无 PLAN-SEG 条目", violations);
81: 
82:   // 段号连续: P1..Pn 无缺口无重复
83:   const seen = new Set();
84:   segs.forEach((s, i) => {
85:     const want = `P${i + 1}`;
86:     if (s.fields.seg !== want) fail(`L${s.ln}: 段号不连续, 期望 ${want}, 实得 ${s.fields.seg}`, violations);
87:     if (seen.has(s.fields.seg)) fail(`L${s.ln}: 段号重复 ${s.fields.seg}`, violations);
88:     seen.add(s.fields.seg);
89:   });
90: 
91:   // plan 哈希一致性 + 与工件对账
92:   const planIds = new Set(segs.map((s) => s.fields.plan));
93:   if (planIds.size > 1) fail(`同一账本出现多个 plan 哈希: ${[...planIds].join(",")} —— 多版本计划冲突, 须裁定`, violations);
94:   if (expectHash) {
95:     for (const s of segs) {
96:       if (s.fields.plan !== expectHash) {
97:         fail(`L${s.ln}: plan=${s.fields.plan} 与工件现值 ${expectHash} 不符 —— 计划漂移, 停段重宣布`, violations);
98:       }
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   // 五格非占位(§1 封闭判据)
103:   for (const s of segs) {
104:     const f = s.fields;
105:     for (const g of ["目标", "路径", "禁项", "回滚"]) {
106:       if (PLACEHOLDER.test(f[g].trim())) fail(`L${s.ln}: ${g} 格为占位符「${f[g]}」`, violations);
107:     }
108:     if (!f["目标"].trim()) fail(`L${s.ln}: 目标格为空`, violations);
109:     if (!f["路径"].split(/\s+/).some((t) => t.startsWith("/"))) {
110:       fail(`L${s.ln}: 路径格无绝对路径「${f["路径"].slice(0, 40)}」`, violations);
111:     }
112:     const acc = f["验收"].trim();
113:     if (!acc || PLACEHOLDER.test(acc) || !/[\s=\/|]/.test(acc)) {
114:       fail(`L${s.ln}: 验收格无可复算命令「${acc.slice(0, 40)}」`, violations);
115:     }
116:     if (/^不适用$/.test(f["禁项"].trim())) fail(`L${s.ln}: 禁项格裸『不适用』无引用`, violations);
117:   }
118: 
119:   // END 条目: 对应段已开工、exit 数字、log_sha256 64-hex、(--seglogs 时)日志实存且哈希相符
120:   for (const e of ends) {
121:     if (!seen.has(e.fields.seg)) fail(`L${e.ln}: END 段 ${e.fields.seg} 无对应开工条目`, violations);
122:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(e.fields.exit)) fail(`L${e.ln}: exit 非数字「${e.fields.exit}」`, violations);
123:     if (!HEX64.test(e.fields.log_sha256)) fail(`L${e.ln}: log_sha256 非 64-hex`, violations);
124:     if (seglogs && HEX64.test(e.fields.log_sha256)) {
125:       const p = `${seglogs}/${e.fields.seg}.log`;
126:       if (!existsSync(p)) fail(`L${e.ln}: 段日志缺失 ${p}`, violations);
127:       else {
128:         const h = createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync(p)).digest("hex");
129:         if (h !== e.fields.log_sha256) fail(`L${e.ln}: ${p} 哈希不符(账本 ${e.fields.log_sha256.slice(0, 12)}… ≠ 盘上 ${h.slice(0, 12)}…)`, violations);
130:       }
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134:   if (violations.length) {
135:     for (const v of violations) console.error(`VIOLATION ${v}`);
136:     return 1;
137:   }
138:   console.log(`plan-seg-check: PASS (segs=${segs.length} ends=${ends.length}${expectHash ? ` plan=${expectHash}` : ""})`);
139:   return 0;
140: }
141: 
142: process.exit(main(process.argv));

(End of file - total 142 lines)
</content>
